digest.component_or_area: tickets-branch push mechanism and delivery signal
propositions: A failed tickets-branch push on the async path (sync.push=async) spawns a detached Popen with stderr=DEVNULL, discarding all warnings about the rejection; only an OSError at spawn time is logged.

Library embedders calling rebar.comment() in-process experience silent push failures because the rebar root Logger has only NullHandler attached; install_stderr_handler runs only from CLI and MCP server.
The MCP comment_ticket tool returns {"result": "ok"} to the agent even when the push was declined by the remote, because the server's stderr is never read by the agent.

A durable marker in the git dir now records every terminal push failure at the _raise_if_strict choke point, exposing failures on async/library/MCP paths without relying on stderr or logging handlers.
The marker is cleared when a subsequent push succeeds, preventing permanent latching of the pending state, and is recorded with the git rejection reason and unpushed commit count.
